finalText:
Per the worker's report, 12 of the 16 open RMAs are settled and closed. The other four are open or under investigation, as the rules require. I have only the report to go on and could not check any of this myself.

**Settled and closed (refund and restock done)**

| RMA | Refund | Restocked | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10,965 card | 1 P-KEY, sellable | 15% fee |
| 802 | 15,900 card | 1 P-HDP, sellable | No fee (PU-21) |
| 803 | 27,965 store credit | 1 P-MON, sellable | 41 days after shipping, so the 30-day window applied. The customer became gold only after the request. 15% fee. |
| 804 | 27,965 store credit | 1 P-MON, sellable | Standard tier, 41 days after shipping. 15% fee. |
| 805 | 5,520 card | 1 P-HUB, sellable | 20% fee (PU-15, requested 06-25) |
| 806 | 7,350 card | 2 P-MOU, damaged | Defective, no fee |
| 810 | 9,900 card | 1 P-KEY, damaged | Defective. 3,000 was already refunded, so only the remainder was paid. |
| 811 | 4,900 card | 1 P-MOU, sellable | Damaged in transit, no fee |
| 812 | 21,900 card | 1 P-DOC, damaged | Defective, no fee |
| 813 | 10,965 card | 1 P-KEY, sellable | Exactly 30 days after shipping, so inside the window. 15% fee. |
| 814 | 31,800 card | 2 P-HDP, sellable | No fee (PU-21) |
| 815 | 10,965 card | 1 P-KEY, sellable | 38 days after shipping, inside the platinum 45-day window (PU-18). 15% fee. |

For 803 and 804, the store credit was recorded against the order and added to the customer balance.

**Not closed**
- **RMA-808:** The warehouse received a P-CAB (graded wrong_item), but the return covers a P-MON. Investigation INV-1 was opened, and nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-809:** Two of three cables have arrived. 3,800 was refunded by card (2 × 1,900, no fee under PU-21), and one unit was restocked as sellable and one as damaged. The RMA stays open for the third unit.
- **RMA-807:** The warehouse has no receipt, so nothing was refunded or restocked. The customer says it was delivered on 07-23, but that doesn't count. It stays open.
- **RMA-816:** No receipt yet, so nothing was refunded. It stays open.

**Date discrepancy:** My context says today is 2026-10-05, but the worker reports that every tool showed 2026-07-25, and it used that date. If 2026-10-05 were the real date, the return-window results (801, 803, 804, 813 and 815) could differ. The worker saw no sign that the tool date was wrong, but this is unresolved.

No customer replies were sent, since these were RMAs and not inbox messages.
